Women Chama Beach Escape Kenyan Coast Getaway

Package overview

A dose of the sea always feels good—and there’s no better way to relax than with your chama sisters by your side.

How about escaping to the beautiful beaches of Mombasa? Spend 4 blissful days in a tropical paradise where your only agenda is to relax, laugh, sip cocktails, and enjoy the ocean breeze.

This is the perfect getaway for bonding, self-care, and creating unforgettable memories together. Whether it’s deep conversations by the beach, fun group activities, or simply soaking up the sun—this trip is all about YOU.
